content: {"praised":["Retro Silver Age style with mature, emotionally gripping story.","Adaptation of Darwyn Cooke's graphic novel, faithful to source.","Strong character ensemble, including Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman.","Engaging Cold War era setting with historical context.","Visually appealing animation, classic DC aesthetic."],"criticized":["Slow pacing, feels dragged.","Unremarkable villain, lacks impact.","Poor chemistry among characters.","Voice acting uninspired, lackluster.","Gratuitous content, unnecessary."]}
